plan:
Run list_files to obtain a complete inventory of all source files.

Run analyze_tools to generate an ecosystem overview (hotspots, orphans, duplicates) and save the output.

Read the saved analyze_tools result file to obtain the full list of top hotspot files.

For each of the top 5 hotspot files, run file_metadata and read_file to examine their full content.

For the most critical hotspot file, run arch_context to retrieve architectural insights.

Run semantic_search with queries like "WorldState refactor" and "bucket 1" to locate code related to architectural concerns.

For each major file identified (from hotspots and semantic search), run file_imports and file_importers to verify dependency direction.

Synthesize all findings into a comprehensive analysis report and save it using write_file.
